method: Node VM executes exact generated release modules, real built inventory and bytes; Cache API/fetch/lifecycle boundaries are controlled doubles. No actual browser, hosting, model inference or device claim.

tests.name: Actual generated manifest matches CP22 exact build identity
Manifest defects rejected before any cache mutation
Install caches only light shell and never skips active-client wait
Prepare all actual build assets with size and SHA256 verification
Notices and all licenses served by generated worker after network removal
Navigation and repeated offline preparation use verified cache
Corrupted cache and changed server bytes fail closed
Unknown release paths denied; model shards remain engine-verified
Abort and denied cache report failure without false offline success
Activation retains previous release cache for rollback
tests.scope: Controlled activation retention, not actual browser update/rollback lifecycle

unqualified: Browser install/wait/activate while a translation is active
Browser network disconnect and model/OCR execution
Rollback to earlier deployment with checkpoint migration
